comments.text: @TechReflex  Thanks for the fast answer!! I thought maybe 165Hz runs more stable for 100fps but i dont know exactly how that works
comments.author: @maxtemp-w2l

comments.text: ​ @maxtemp-w2l Hz is completely different from stability. With freesync/gsync, all frames are 'stable', how consistent frame rate you get depends on your GPU. Faster Hz doesn't mean less stable, it just means smoother. There are even 1000Hz monitors, but perceivable benefits diminish after 240Hz.
